about.founderNote: When I founded Jakarta BC in 2019, I'd already watched a dozen friends abandon Indonesia ventures over avoidable licensing surprises. The premise of this firm is simple: tell investors what it actually takes, with real numbers and real timelines. No theater. Diah Putri, Founder.
